stem.text: What occurs during the formation of a peptide bond between two amino acids?

A.text: $\text{OH}$ is removed from $\text{COOH}$ and $\text{H}$ is removed from an R group.

B.text: $\text{OH}$ is removed from $\text{COOH}$ and $\text{H}$ is removed from $\text{NH}_2$.

C.text: $\text{H}$ is removed from $\text{COOH}$ and $\text{OH}$ is removed from an R group.

D.text: $\text{O}$ is removed from $\text{COOH}$ and $2\text{H}$ is removed from $\text{NH}_2$.
